definitions.explanation: The act of running and controlling a business or organization.
The ongoing operation of a business entity.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{小|ちい}さな{会社|かいしゃ}を{経営|けいえい}している。
examples.english: My father runs a small company.

examples.japanese: {経営|けいえい}が{厳|きび}しくなってきた。
examples.english: The business situation has become difficult.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{大学|だいがく}で{経営|けいえい}{学|がく}を{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: He studied business administration at university.

examples.japanese: {経営|けいえい}{者|しゃ}として{成功|せいこう}するには、リーダーシップが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: To succeed as a business manager, leadership is necessary.

examples.japanese: {経営|けいえい}{学|がく}の{教授|きょうじゅ}が{新|あたら}しい{理論|りろん}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: A professor of business administration published a new theory.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}が{始|はじ}めた{店|みせ}を、{今|いま}は{母|はは}が{経営|けいえい}している。
examples.english: My mother now runs the shop that my grandfather started.

notes:
{経営|けいえい} refers to the management and operation of businesses.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {会社|かいしゃ}を{経営|けいえい}する (to run a company)
- {店|みせ}を{経営|けいえい}する (to run a shop)
- {経営|けいえい}に{携|たずさ}わる (to be involved in management)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {経営|けいえい}{者|しゃ} (manager, proprietor)
- {経営|けいえい}{学|がく} (business administration)
- {経営|けいえい}{戦略|せんりゃく} (business strategy)
- {経営|けいえい}{難|なん} (financial difficulties)
- {経営|けいえい}{陣|じん} (management team)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {経営|けいえい}: running a business (overall control)
- {管理|かんり}: management, administration (day-to-day control)
- {運営|うんえい}: operation (of organizations, events)
